interpretation.root: Root markers only. Public whole-step perturbation versus bracketing plain is about +1.6 to +2.0 percent; GP controls show timing variability.
interpretation.limited_functions: Two selections of 16 methods reuse the existing profiler without parameter/result capture. Inclusive rows overlap. Exclusive subtracts only selected descendants and still includes unwrapped methods, engine and native work.
interpretation.observer: Recorded handler bodies do not measure all wrapper/dispatch overhead. Subtracting observer time never reconstructs a plain run.
interpretation.tail: Short GP P99 is the maximum; same-source plain GP851 varies substantially. No timing difference is claimed to be caused by an optimization.
interpretation.unresolved: Exact owner/caller attribution within signatures, per-step CPU scheduling/frequency, and a safe way to share current dynamic dependencies remain unproved.
